title: Imperium of Man (Warhammer 40,000) — Before Philosophy Got Polite #Shorts
description:
Reproduction explains more of Imperium of Man (Warhammer 40,000) than any philosophy dares to admit. Warhammer 40,000 (also known as WH40K or 40K), is a British miniature wargame produced by Games Workshop. It is the most popular miniature wargame in the world, and is particularly popular in the United Kingdom.

Imperium of Man (Warhammer 40,000) did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. For instance, a model of a Space Marine armed with a "boltgun" weapon can shoot any enemy unit within 24 inches. Most of the races in the game have units with psychic powers, who are called psykers.
